title: On the Evaluation of the Plausibility and Faithfulness of Sentiment Analysis Explanations
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the 'plausibility' and 'faithfulness' of sentiment analysis explanations. 'Plausibility' refers to agreement with human judgment on rationales, and 'faithfulness' refers to how well explanations reflect the model's internal logic. These are technical evaluation metrics for explainability and do not inherently deal with religious, moral, or ethical values as a core component of the evaluation. While accountability is mentioned, the core of the evaluation is not about ethics directly.
